about: The body archetypes (looks wave 2, stream bodies, 2026-10-14): what was built and how it was checked. Machine checks only: a green verify is not the creator's acceptance; nobody has played it.
brief: Build body archetypes as standards beside gf-humanoid-1 (worm/serpent, blob, quadruped, flyer): rig standard, validator, procedural animation from the humanoid's actions, multiplayer, slot/body declaration; an auto-rig path; fix or redo the moss-mole glitch; the pilot creatures playable in a three standard-3d example with two players, passing the six gates.
autorig: builder/art/rig/autorig.mjs; gamesfun art autorig; art ingest --autorig
judge: builder/tools/lib/creature-judge.mjs, through rig-check and measure 19 (gate A widened; no new measure)
mossMole: Meshy's biped rig of moss-mole (looks-pilot-artillery/moss-mole-rigged) still fails; redone as moss-mole-blob on gf-blob-1 by autorig, passes the creature judge (private pack, local).
standIns: library/packs/xk-creature-bodies (worm-pink, snake-green, slime-blue, pup-tan, bird-red; CC0, made by runtimes/three/tools/creatures.mjs and rigged by autorig): all pass; strip stand-ins-strip.jpg (the creature bench's film timeline).

example.note: two-player live gate (E 5) and friends (E 25) pass with the host an ember-newt and the joiner a moss-mole, each drawn on the other's screen; the pilot critters' screenshots and films stay local (private art).

artilleryCase: Re-rendered the artillery reference case (look-target's pitch, game puff-artillery, pack looks-pilot-artillery) with the creature lever: the hero is now the rigged ember-newt and all three critters stand posed, where wave 1 showed Meshy's torn moss-mole. By eye the characters move from about 7 to about 7.5 of 10 and the whole stays about 5 of 10: the world (a fenced yard), the camera and the HUD dominate. No measured score: the look judge (builder/look/judge.mjs) is not on this branch's base. Sheets kept in the private evaluation folder, never in a repository.
